rows.title: Melatonin Supplementation Improves Pain, Sleep Quality, and Total Plasma Antioxidant Capacity in Women with Fibrocystic Breast Disease: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Trial.
rows.journal: Journal of research in pharmacy practice
rows.focus: Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial in 66 women with fibrocystic breast disease found 12 weeks of melatonin improved sleep quality and breast pain versus placebo; depression, anxiety, hs-CRP, and MDA did not differ significantly.
